market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate near recent highs with bank-led gains offset by AUD weakness and energy volatility. Fed rate decision and RBA commentary will drive direction. Qantas strike and fuel supply crunch add near-term noise. Expect 1-2% range-bound trading.
market_outlook.long_term: IMF fiscal warning and potential RBA hike cap upside for rate-sensitive sectors. Mining exploration pipeline and AI infrastructure capex provide structural support. Consumer squeeze and housing affordability constraints weigh on domestic demand. Net: cautious constructive, favour exporters and infrastructure over domestic consumer.
